# Bakajātaka (Ja 405)

**ID:** Ja 405
**Section:** Jātaka (ja)
**Collection:** Suttas-Late-1
**Title (Pali):** Bakajātaka
**Title (English, SuttaCentral):** The Crane
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/ja405

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Bakajātaka* (Ja 405, also cited as the *Brahmā Baka Jātaka*) is a canonical birth-story preserved in the Jātaka collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral; Bodhi 2003]. According to the traditional introductory setting, the Buddha recounted this tale while residing at Jetavana concerning the deity Baka Brahmā [SuttaCentral]. The name *Baka* literally translates to "crane," a bird traditionally regarded in Indian folklore as an archetype of deceit and cunning [Bodhi 2003].

The episode and verses of Ja 405 directly correspond to the *Bakabrahmasutta* of the *Brahma Saṁyutta* (SN 6.4), whose opening prose parallels that of the *Brahmanimantanika Sutta* (MN 49) [Bodhi 2003]. This relationship is confirmed by automated text-reuse analysis in DharmaNexus, which matches the verses of Ja 405 (§1.1–8.4) with SN 6 (§4.3.6–4.11.4) at a 0.97 similarity rating, agreeing with SuttaCentral's identification of SN 6.4 as a full parallel [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records Pali textual matches in the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* and the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā*, alongside cross-language alignments with Chinese translations in the *Saṁyuktāgama* (T 99) and the alternative *Saṁyuktāgama* (T 100) [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Full parallels (SuttaCentral): SN 6.4 Bakabrahmasutta
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā (Tatiyo bhāgo) (Atk S0513a3) (§4.1–7.4 ↔ §3275–3286); Brahma Saṁyutta (SN 6) (§1.1–8.4 ↔ §4.3.6–4.11.4); Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0201a) (§8.1–8.4 ↔ §2864_2–2868)
- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): 雜阿含經 (ZH_T02_0099) [zh]; 別譯雜阿含經 (ZH_T02_0100) [zh]
